# Skeleton

The bones of a loading layout.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Skeleton` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Skeleton />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Skeleton"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One skeleton bone (aria-hidden). Put aria-busy and a spoken label on the region: LoadingRegion or StateView do it for you.

## Props (SkeletonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'text' \| 'rect' \| 'circle' \| 'pill'` | text: one or more bars (ragged, last one shorter). rect: a block. circle: an avatar. pill: a chip or button. @default "text" |
| `width` | `number \| string` |  |
| `height` | `number \| string` |  |
| `lines` | `number` | Number of bars for text. @default 1 |
| `lineWidths` | `Array<number \| string>` | Width of each text bar, repeating, e.g. ['92%', '58%']. |
| `size` | `'caption' \| 'body' \| 'title' \| 'heading' \| 'metric'` | Text bar height: caption 0.7em, body 0.9em, title 1.25em, heading 1.7em, metric 2.6em. @default "body" |
| `radius` | `number \| string` | Override corner radius. |
| `animation` | `'wave' \| 'pulse' \| 'none'` | wave: one shine that crosses the page in step. pulse: a calm fade. none: still. Reduced motion is always still. @default "wave" |
| `onInk` | `boolean` | On-ink tint for navy panels. @default false |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>._
